- Band n50 and n74 were removed from the specification
- The GSCN ranges for Band n261 are added
- Editor’s notes are removed, except for two notes in 9.7.5.3.2 concerning Spurious emissions for FR2.
- Square brackets are removed in subclauses 5.4.3, 6.6.5.2.2, 7.4.1.2, 7.7.2, 10.5.1.2, 10.6.2.2, 10.8.2 and 10.8.3.
- For the text in BS type 2-O multi-band requirement in 9.7.4.3.1, the text is removed together with the brackets, since it is agreed to not have BS type 2-O multi-band in Rel-15.
- The freqeuncy offsets for 90 MHz BW are corrected (swapped) in Table 7.7.2-2 and Table 10.8.2-2.
- The remaining “guidance” text is removed from 9.1


Several editorial changes are made in addition.
